title: Sharper embedding-degree trace bound (N2)
question: For every prime power q and M >= 1, the number of M-bad traces t (as in HYP-eff2cfbb) is at most 2*sum_{m<=M} phi(m) - M.
rationale: Corrected variant produced by the ECDLP-5 counterexample run; recorded separately, original kept.
